michelle_prod: Internal preview: were trialing a new L4m Dedicated pool in eu-north-1 (zones a/c) with a new 'spot-dedicated' reservation option for cost-sensitive, non-SLA workloads. Limited capacity for previews and migrations.

devin_infra: Quick facts: 14 L4m GPUs total (7 per zone). Soft per-account cap = 4 GPUs/zone. New reservation_type values: "standard", "enterprise", and "spot-dedicated". Spot-dedicated = ~40% off standard price, but may be reclaimed with 10m notice and has no SLA. To request >soft-cap, submit quota request under "Dedicated GPU - L4m" and indicate reservation_type.

sam_support: Support process: tag tickets with "dedicated-eun-l4m" and include reservation_type in the request. Spot requests should include tolerance to 10m preemption. We'll add a KB explaining preemption handling and migration steps.

infra-bot: Pool telemetry snapshot: eu-north-1a/c p95 token-latency 49ms, p99 83ms, avg gpu util 44%. No failed nodes. Spare capacity 28%.

laura_sales: For customer offers: can AMs mix reservation types across a single customer (eg 2 standard + 2 spot) to lower costs while keeping baseline capacity?

michelle_prod: Yes, mixed reservations allowed. Recommend pairing spot-dedicated for batch or background workloads and standard/hard-reserve for latency-sensitive routes. Sales can propose mixed bundles; finance must approve any custom discounts.

henry_fin: Financial policy: spot-dedicated pricing uses a billing credit model. If a spot allocation is preempted, customers are credited the unused portion of that hour pro-rata. We'll publish sample billing scenarios in the pricing doc.

zara_privacy: Privacy/regulatory note: spot-dedicated cannot be used for workloads requiring strict regional isolation or data residency guarantees because of potential cross-zone fallback. We'll add a guardrail in the reservation UI to block spot for tenants with "data_residency_required" flag.

devin_infra: Action items: (1) add reservation_type and preemption_notice_mins (int) to reservation API @devin_infra, (2) support to publish KB and ticket template @sam_support, (3) privacy to add UI guardrail @zara_privacy, (4) finance to finalize billing credit rules @henry_fin.

michelle_prod: Maintenance note: driver tuning scheduled Fri 2026-04-10 02:00-03:00 UTC; we'll do staggered updates and prefer spot drain during that window. Customers using spot-dedicated should expect preemptions as part of validation.

laura_sales: I'll update AMs and productize FAQs. Any pilot slots for partners?

michelle_prod: 4 pilot slots reserved for partners and key enterprise customers willing to test preemption flows. AMs, please add requests to the pilot tracker and mark whether customer consented to spot preemptions.

devin_infra: Will push API changes and a feature flag for UI lockstep. Also enabling a dashboard tile to show spot reclaim events per-region.

michelle_prod: We'll hold public comms until 72h of stable telemetry and one maintenance cycle. Thanks team :sparkles: Reply here with blockers.
